''See also: [[Bliss of the Blackwatch Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Bliss is the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Head of the Blackwatch]] [[Guild]], an organization dedicated to studying [[Elders]] and utilizing their powers for the benefit of humanity. She is characterized by her otherworldly appearance, possessing pale skin, white-blond hair, and eyes that can glow with a pale light. Her attire typically consists of a long black coat featuring silver buttons, each etched with the [[Crest of the Blackwatch|Blackwatch crest]]—a design depicting six inhuman eyes over a mass of tentacles. Bliss is described as having an ageless quality, with observers finding it difficult to determine her true age; she has been perceived as anywhere from a young child to a woman in her early twenties. As a leader, Bliss possesses formidable power and an intense, frightening presence that radiates a [[hunger]] for change and a rejection of natural laws. She utilizes specialized weaponry, including the [[Spear of Tharlos]] and [[Blackwatch spikes]]—ancient [[Iron|iron]] nails used to pin down or seal [[Elderspawn]]. Her role involves high-level decision-making, such as placing individuals under her personal supervision or managing dangerous artifacts like the [[Optasia]]. While some view her as a quirky or strange figure, she is recognized as a dangerous and highly capable combatant who serves as an emergency measure for [[The Empire|the Empire]]. Despite her [[Authority|authority]], she is a figure of controversy, and there have been recorded desires among certain groups to see her removed from her position.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Bliss is a woman with pale skin, white-blond hair, and pale eyes that shine with light when she opens them. She wears a long black coat featuring silver buttons etched with the [[Crest of the Blackwatch|Blackwatch Crest]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A leader and [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Head of the Blackwatch]] [[Guild]], Bliss is notoriously unpredictable and unreliable. She is motivated by a desire for revenge against her father, [[Nathanael Bareius]], and believes that a world lacking an Emperor would face grave danger.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Bliss is the daughter of [[Nathanael Bareius]], though she intends to seek revenge against him. She interacts with [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] and [[Cheska Bennett|Cheska]], and is viewed by [[Calder]] as someone who might be able to provide assistance.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Bliss possesses the ability to change her location and can cleanse her [[blood]] to remove foreign agents. She utilizes a [[Spear of Tharlos]], a [[Soulbound Vessel]], and rough-forged [[Iron|iron]] spikes as weapons.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Blackwatch service}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Bliss is known for being notoriously unreliable during their service.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref> The individual carries a [[black iron spike]] and a spear made of yellowed bone.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> There has been a suggestion to remove Bliss from their position.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> While serving, Bliss wears a [[Blackwatch coat]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] is considered notoriously unreliable.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] possesses a [[black iron spike]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|There is a suggestion to remove [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bliss of the Blackwatch]] wears a [[Blackwatch coat]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] possesses a spear of yellowed bone.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Bliss finally looked up, adding, “I’d like it if he were sane, but I will work with what I can get.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c28" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Calder edged closer to Bliss. “Is the Optasia inside the Emperor’s rooms?”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“I have one of Tharlos’ bones in my pocket.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Bliss says the last Consultants to escape were carrying something, but she couldn’t stop them.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“What about you, Bliss? What do you think?”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}
